extractions.description: Introduces the JaxPruner JAX library and empirically benchmarks dense, pruning, and sparse-training baselines across image classification, federated character recognition, language modeling, and deep reinforcement learning.

type.quote: We benchmark pruning and sparse training algorithms in 4 different domains and discuss them in subsequent sections
type.justification: The paper implements software and reports numerical benchmark experiments, so it is empirical.

name.quote: This work introduces JaxPruner, a JAX-based sparsity library for machine learning research.
name.justification: The library and experiments directly advance machine-learning sparsity research.
